The '''Little Atullus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Little Atullus]].
